description: This Java source file defines the class `CentersWorkbookPopulator`, which extends `AbstractWorkbookPopulator`. It is responsible for populating an Excel workbook with a sheet designed for bulk import of center data, including layout setup, lookup tables, data validation rules, and related configuration for import menus. The class interacts with other populators for offices, personnel, and groups, and manages cell styles, validation constraints, and named ranges specific to center import operations.
